svg.title: The principal weak commutator and the natural-dual regularizer limit
svg.desc: The real principal commutator equals minus twice the imaginary weak source plus twice the imaginary lower form minus twice the imaginary lower defect. The full regularizer commutator maps the energy space to its antidual and converges to the cutoff commutator for a fixed input.
svg.text: Principal weak commutator: keep all forcing terms
Cλ = −2 Im ⟨Aλ f, Aλu⟩ + 2 Im q₁(Aλu,Aλu) − 2 Im Δ₁,λ
q₀ is Hermitian; q₁ may be complex. The sign uses the linear-first convention. (WC13)
order Q₋ = s − 1 = ν − 3/2. One ordinary normal derivative per factor. (WC8–WC12)
Regularized equation: retain the variable-coefficient error
Eᵣ: V → V* is uniformly bounded at fixed supports; the full form is used. (WC16–WC18)
Λᵣf → χf, Eᵣu → P(χu) − χPu strongly in V*
Both form domains. Fixed input and widths. The cutoff error can remain nonzero. (WC19–WC21)
The positive-symbol factor and the higher-order microlocal regularizer estimate remain to be proved.
